(These moments have taught me the importance of [curly braces] nurturing deep, meaningful relationships, even in the absence of siblings.) But it's only in recent years that I've come to understand the true weight of carrying family expectations alone. (This realization has forced me to confront the fact that I've been [square brackets] shouldering the burden of my family's hopes and dreams, often at the expense of my own desires and needs.)
